opinions.snippet:
Chief Justice ROBERTS delivered the opinion of the Court.
 

  A Texas jury convicted petitioner Duane Buck of capital murder. Under state law, the jury could impose a death sentence only if it found that Buck was likely to commit acts of violence in the future.
